capabilities: Read EPUB and PDF files as Obsidian tabs with chapter navigation, search and position memory
Annotate selected text via a Gloss toolbar with highlights, notes and bookmarks
Write annotations to a linked companion markdown note with frontmatter, tags and callouts
Ask AI modes (Explain, Examine, Enquiry) about passages via local or cloud providers
Browse a Library shelf of books and PDFs with reading progress and annotation counts
extras: README discloses the code is largely AI-generated with the author directing design and review; licensed AGPL-3.0; DRM-encrypted EPUBs are detected and refused; importing books from outside the vault is desktop-only; full pop-out window support is still on the todo list; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author found that reading in one app and taking notes in another scatters thinking, and wanted highlights, annotations and questions kept in the vault as ordinary markdown with nothing to sync or export.
problem: Reading and note-taking usually happen in separate apps, so highlights and the thoughts around them end up scattered across formats you never revisit.
